name: Hokuto (Yamanashi, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hokuto city emblem in green and blue: two facing stylised strokes in green and blue, like leaves or wings.
history: Municipal flag of Hokuto, a city in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 2004.

features.role: Hokuto city emblem — two facing stylised strokes in green and blue, like leaves or wings
